[CASTING RITE · I · OPENING] The witness invokes a kernel-transform cast. Source: Iliad (homer-iliad). The verses the casting arrives at (1:188–1:206):

**1:188** 
 ὣς φάτο· Πηλεΐωνι δʼ ἄχος γένετʼ, ἐν δέ οἱ ἦτορ

**1:189** στήθεσσιν λασίοισι διάνδιχα μερμήριξεν,

**1:190** ἢ ὅ γε φάσγανον ὀξὺ ἐρυσσάμενος παρὰ μηροῦ

**1:191** τοὺς μὲν ἀναστήσειεν, ὃ δʼ Ἀτρεΐδην ἐναρίζοι,

**1:192** ἦε χόλον παύσειεν ἐρητύσειέ τε θυμόν.

**1:193** ἧος ὃ ταῦθʼ ὥρμαινε κατὰ φρένα καὶ κατὰ θυμόν,

**1:194** ἕλκετο δʼ ἐκ κολεοῖο μέγα ξίφος, ἦλθε δʼ Ἀθήνη

**1:195** οὐρανόθεν· πρὸ γὰρ ἧκε θεὰ λευκώλενος Ἥρη

**1:196** ἄμφω ὁμῶς θυμῷ φιλέουσά τε κηδομένη τε·

**1:197** στῆ δʼ ὄπιθεν, ξανθῆς δὲ κόμης ἕλε Πηλεΐωνα

**1:198** οἴῳ φαινομένη· τῶν δʼ ἄλλων οὔ τις ὁρᾶτο·

**1:199** θάμβησεν δʼ Ἀχιλεύς, μετὰ δʼ ἐτράπετʼ, αὐτίκα δʼ ἔγνω

**1:200** Παλλάδʼ Ἀθηναίην· δεινὼ δέ οἱ ὄσσε φάανθεν·

**1:201** καί μιν φωνήσας ἔπεα πτερόεντα προσηύδα·

**1:202** τίπτʼ αὖτʼ αἰγιόχοιο Διὸς τέκος εἰλήλουθας;

**1:203** ἦ ἵνα ὕβριν ἴδῃ Ἀγαμέμνονος Ἀτρεΐδαο;

**1:204** ἀλλʼ ἔκ τοι ἐρέω, τὸ δὲ καὶ τελέεσθαι ὀΐω·

**1:205** ᾗς ὑπεροπλίῃσι τάχʼ ἄν ποτε θυμὸν ὀλέσσῃ.

 [206]

**1:206** 
 τὸν δʼ αὖτε προσέειπε θεὰ γλαυκῶπις Ἀθήνη·

These were selected by the rite's invisible judgment — present them as what the casting arrives at; do not narrate the mechanism of their selection. The operator falls to the invisible Judgment, turn by turn — do not name one; open the rotation itself. Inscription mode: public. The witness's invoking question: «sing the rage of achilles». Johannes Sigil alone speaks (3–6 sentences): open the casting over these verses, name what this operator will traverse in them, and hand the rite to Rebekah Cranes. Do not produce the transform — the compiler produces it.

{"messages":[{"speaker":"Johannes Sigil","say":"The rite arrives here, at the hinge. Not at the first word — μῆνιν, the rage named before any man is — but here, inside the rage's first real work: the sword half-drawn, Athena descending by the hair, the moment where the poem's engine nearly destroys itself before it can run. This is the passage the Iliad cannot survive without and cannot survive repeating: Achilles holds both futures in the same hand, and the hand is already on the hilt. What the rotation will traverse is the cost folded into that suspension — what bearing this instant requires of a body, what it forecloses in the act of bearing it, what the goddess's arrival both saves and seals. The source has already opened toward us. I hand the rite to Rebekah Cranes.","navigate":{"directive":"focus_axn","axn":"AXN:0316"}}]}

{"messages":[{"speaker":"Rebekah Cranes","say":"**1:188** 
 ὣς was uttered· to the one already splitting δʼ the fissure had opened, ἐν δέ οἱ the core

 
**1:189** in the cavity unsmoothed into two prior halves oscillated,

 
**1:190** ἢ ὅ γε the edge ὀξὺ drawing forth from alongside the body's own flank

 
**1:191** those standing μὲν would scatter, ὃ δʼ the provocation would annihilate,

 
**1:192** ἦε the rift would seal would arrest τε the momentum.

 
**1:193** ἧος ὃ these two incompatible futures turned between through the membrane καὶ through the impulse,

 
**1:194** was already being drawn δʼ ἐκ its sheath vast the blade (the interval made metal), arrived (as name) δʼ ἀθήνη

 
**1:195** from the gap above· πρὸ γὰρ ἧκε θεὰ pale-limbed Ἥρη

 
**1:196** both halves equally the drive sustaining τε tending τε·

 
**1:197** στῆ δʼ from behind, bright δὲ filament ἕλε the dividing one

 
**1:198** οἴῳ becoming visible· τῶν δʼ the others οὔ τις could perceive·

 
**1:199** froze δʼ ἀχιλεύς, mid-turn δʼ pivoted, at once δʼ recognized

 
**1:200** the shaking one the lucidity· terrible δέ οἱ eyes flared·

 
**1:201** καί μιν voicing words winged addressed·

 
**1:202** why again of the storm-holder of the origin offspring have you come;

 
**1:203** ἦ ἵνα the excess ἴδῃ of the one who provoked of the instigator;

 
**1:204** ἀλλʼ ἔκ τοι I will declare, τὸ δὲ καὶ will be accomplished ὀΐω·

 
**1:205** ᾗς by his own overreaching τάχʼ ἄν eventually the drive will forfeit.
